scenarios.title: No fault
scenarios.what: The same schedule with nothing injected: the reference for every other scenario.

scenarios.title: Crash the busiest leader (SIGKILL)
scenarios.what: SIGKILL the node leading the most shards; restart it from its data directory 10 s later (power loss: in-memory state is gone, the WAL survives).

scenarios.title: Crash, election timeout 250 ms
scenarios.what: As crash-leader, with the election timeout halved (heartbeat 25 ms).

scenarios.title: Crash, election timeout 1 s
scenarios.what: As crash-leader, with the election timeout doubled (heartbeat 100 ms).

scenarios.title: Graceful stop of the busiest leader (SIGTERM)
scenarios.what: SIGTERM: the node transfers its leaderships (TimeoutNow) before exiting; restarted 10 s later.

scenarios.title: Pause the busiest leader (SIGSTOP)
scenarios.what: Freeze the process for 10 s (a long GC pause or a stalled VM), then SIGCONT. Its leases must lapse before others take over.

scenarios.title: Pause, client without a per-attempt timeout
scenarios.what: As pause-leader with the client's per-attempt timeout disabled, as it was before this study: each request waits on the frozen leader for its whole 5 s deadline.

scenarios.title: Partition the busiest leader
scenarios.what: Cut the leader off from all peers for 10 s (clients can still reach it). Check-quorum must demote it and the majority elect replacements.

scenarios.title: Partition two nodes (a minority)
scenarios.what: Isolate the two busiest leaders for 10 s. Shards with two of their three replicas on that side lose quorum and must refuse requests (CP).

scenarios.title: Flapping partition (1 s on, 1 s off, x5)
scenarios.what: Isolate and reconnect the busiest leader five times in a row, faster than leadership can settle.

scenarios.title: Slow links: +50 ms on the busiest leader
scenarios.what: Delay every Raft message to and from the leader by 50 ms for 10 s (a congested or distant link).

scenarios.title: Slow links: +200 ms on the busiest leader
scenarios.what: As slow-link-50ms with 200 ms, close to the 500 ms election timeout.

scenarios.title: Lossy links: 30% of the leader's messages dropped
scenarios.what: Drop 30% of Raft messages to and from the leader for 10 s.

scenarios.title: Rolling restart of all nodes
scenarios.what: Gracefully stop and restart every node in turn, waiting for full health before the next, as an upgrade would.
